why.B2.2: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a possible diagnosis given the patient's age and the presence of a large mediastinal mass, but it is less specific than primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma.
why.B3.2: Hodgkin lymphoma is a less likely diagnosis due to the atypical imaging features and the presence of a large mediastinal mass, which is more characteristic of non-Hodgkin lymphoma or primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma.
why.B4.2: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is also a possible diagnosis, but it has a lower local score and explanatory coverage compared to primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma.
